title: MotrpacHumanPreSuspensionAnalysis: Complete Package Overview
text: 33 contrasts organized five types, addressing different biological question: exercise_with_controls (10 contrasts) — primary analysis. Compares exercise group (Endurance Resistance) time-matched controls using delta-delta design: (exercise post - exercise pre) - (control post - control pre). removes baseline differences isolates exercise-specific response. exercise_no_controls (10 contrasts) — Within-group change baseline exercise group (post - pre), without adjusting control group changes. purely comparison describe effect controls. presented main result manuscript. Endur_vs_Resist (4 contrasts) — Direct comparison endurance vs. resistance exercise post-exercise timepoint (delta-delta design). Identifies modality-differing responses. baseline (3 contrasts) — Pre-exercise differences groups (Endurance vs. Resistance, Endurance vs. Control, Resistance vs. Control). Verifies randomization identifies pre-existing group differences. Also evaluates potential effect familiarization protocol. control_only (6 contrasts) — Control group changes time relative pre-exercise baseline. Captures effects fasting, biopsy, circadian variation unrelated exercise.
